verdict.rationale: NotebookLM offers a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to—chat Q&A with citations, generating study guides, audio/video overviews, quizzes, mind maps, slide decks—covering many generative tasks (notebooklm-docs-2,3,14,15,16,17,19). However, community evidence shows a concrete limitation: the assistant cannot autonomously search for and pull in sources, requiring users to manually supply docs/URLs (notebooklm-comm-4), and interactive/agentic features like conversing with generated podcasts are described as janky (notebooklm-comm-3), constraining true task delegation. Missing for 10: autonomous source discovery/search, broader multi-step agentic task execution beyond content generation, independent validation that assistant reliably completes delegated tasks.
